pages.title: Working the hologram
pages.text: $(li)Right-click a machine to open its hologram.$(li)Aim at a button and $(thing)left-click$() to press it.$(li)$(thing)Double-click$() item slots to craft, transfer blueprints or set filters.$(li)Hover for tooltips.$(br2)Face the hologram so you can aim at its controls.

pages.title: Window controls
pages.text: The small bordered controls sit along the top-right edge.$(br2)$(thing)X$() closes the panel. $(thing)?$() opens its Tablet entry when available.$(br2)The $(thing)pushpin$() keeps a block panel open when you look away. A green upright pin means pinned. Click again to restore the normal timeout; X still closes it. Pins survive chunk reloads during play, but clear when the world is reopened.$(br2)Mounted panels omit X and pin; equipment panels omit pin.

pages.title: Switches and shortcuts
pages.text: Redstone controls usually cycle between always enabled, enabled without a signal, and enabled with a signal. A machine still needs its normal supplies.$(br2)Armor configuration defaults to the top-row $(thing)0$() key. Module groups 1 and 2 default to Numpad $(thing)7$() and $(thing)8$(). Check Controls for conflicts or changed bindings.
